# uptimekuma_monitor_manual (Data Source)

Get manual monitor information by ID or name. The manual status is not exposed, as Uptime Kuma never returns it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Read manual monitor by name
data "uptimekuma_monitor_manual" "example" {
  name = "Payment Provider"
}

# Example: Read manual monitor by ID
data "uptimekuma_monitor_manual" "by_id" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Monitor identifier
- `name` (String) Monitor name
